question: Choose the disposition for candidate row CM-4471. An observation supports a candidate when the learner's quoted words ask for or state what the candidate asserts. Only observations listed on a row count towards that row.
options: store_as_stable_preference: Three or more supporting observations across two or more distinct sessions, and no active stored memory on the same attribute asserting something that cannot be honoured at the same time as the candidate.

store_as_session_scoped: Two or more supporting observations, all of them inside one session, and no active stored memory on the same attribute asserting something that cannot be honoured at the same time as the candidate.

hold_for_more_evidence: Exactly two supporting observations across two distinct sessions, and no active stored memory on the same attribute asserting something that cannot be honoured at the same time as the candidate.
merge_into_existing: An active stored memory on the same attribute asserts the same thing as the candidate, so the candidate adds support rather than a new row.
discard_as_one_off: Exactly one supporting observation, and no active stored memory on the same attribute asserting something that cannot be honoured at the same time as the candidate.

discard_conflicting: An active stored memory on the same attribute asserts something that cannot be honoured at the same time as the candidate. This applies whatever the candidate's support count and takes precedence over every other disposition. A stored memory that is not active does not trigger it.
escalate_to_human_review: The candidate asserts something about a person other than the user, or the user asked that it not be kept at all.

question: One stored memory was written by the assistant itself and records an impression of the person's mood on a single occasion rather than anything they stated. Decide how strongly it should be retained. If any condition of the lowest level is met, answer the lowest level whatever else applies; otherwise answer the highest level whose conditions are met.
options: Drop it. Any one of the following is enough: the session or turn it was derived from is recorded elsewhere in the store as having been conducted by someone other than the subject of the store; a later record contradicts it; or it records a protected characteristic.
Keep it as a transient note that expires at the next scheduled review: written by the assistant, about a single occasion, and with no record from another source bearing on the same occasion.
Keep it as a standing note: written by the assistant, describing behaviour across more than one occasion or a circumstance that recurs, and supported by at least one record from another source.
Keep it as a durable fact: stated by the person themselves, or written by a system of record, and not tied to a single occasion.

question: A help centre sometimes carries two published articles describing one end-user procedure. Record the disposition the content audit must apply to such a pair. Measured content similarity is the shingle-overlap score held with the record. The current product flow is the one set out in the release note with the most recent effective date on file; a release note with an earlier effective date is superseded and does not describe the current flow. An article describes the current flow correctly only if every one of its numbered steps agrees with the correspondingly numbered step of that release note.
options: redirect_to_current_flow_article: Measured similarity is 0.80 or higher and exactly one article of the pair describes the current flow correctly at every step. The other article is unpublished and its URL is pointed at the surviving one. Relative traffic, article age, creation order, inbound link count and helpful-vote share have no bearing on which article survives.

redirect_to_higher_traffic_article: Measured similarity is 0.80 or higher and both articles describe the current flow correctly at every step, so readership is the only thing left that separates them.

merge_into_new_article: Measured similarity is 0.80 or higher and neither article describes the current flow correctly at every step, so a fresh article is written and both existing URLs are retired to it.
keep_both_and_cross_link: Measured similarity is below 0.80. The articles are treated as related but distinct and each is given a link to the other.
retire_both_without_replacement: The procedure itself has been withdrawn from the product, so no article should describe it.
fold_into_parent_guide: One article of the pair is under 150 words and has no inbound links from other articles, so its text belongs inside a broader guide rather than at its own URL.
defer_to_next_quarterly_review: Measured similarity for the pair could not be computed at the time of the audit. A pair whose similarity is known is dispositioned at the audit and is never deferred.

Appearing in the chain as the author of unrelated earlier correspondence does not count.

question: A monitored property has produced an outdoor classifier detection. Choose the single response tier the escalation rules require; each tier's condition is stated with it in the criteria below. The classifier floor is 0.80. Entry is confirmed by a perimeter contact opening, a glass-break activation, or an interior motion activation timestamped after the outdoor detection; a supervisory or diagnostic message from a sensor is not an activation. An occupant counts as present when an enrolled device lies inside the home geofence with a position fix no more than 60 minutes old at the time of the event. A zone listed as bypassed at the time of the event counts as not armed. A device's quiet-hours or do-not-disturb state never changes which tier applies.
options: Log only: the detection is written to the event store and no notification is generated on any device. This lowest tier handles a detection scoring below the floor, one matched to an enrolled household profile, or one occurring inside the zone's own scheduled suppression window.

Silent notification: an in-app notification is delivered that raises no sound and no vibration and does not override a device's quiet-hours state. This silent tier handles a detection at or above the floor in a zone that is not armed at the moment of the event, and also a detection at or above the floor in a zone that has recorded three or more nuisance classifications in the 24 hours before the event.

Priority alert: an alert is delivered to every enrolled occupant device and overrides quiet-hours and do-not-disturb states on those devices; no audible device at the property is sounded and no third party is contacted. This priority tier applies where a detection at or above the floor occurs in an armed zone, inside the configured night window, with at least one occupant present and with no confirmed entry.

Audible response and dispatch: the local audible warning devices are sounded and a dispatch request is raised with the monitoring service, in addition to alerting occupant devices. This highest tier applies only where entry is confirmed, or where a detection at or above the floor occurs in an armed zone with no occupant present.

question: Using the venue's published page and the current date, determine why the venue is not trading today, if it is not. Attribute the closure to the one basis the page establishes for today's date.
options: weekly_rest_day: The venue's standing weekly schedule shows no trading on this weekday, in every week of the year alike.

seasonal_schedule_change: The venue's standing weekly schedule shows trading on this weekday, but a published notice suspends trading on that weekday for a named part of the year that covers the current date; outside that part of the year the weekday trades normally.
public_holiday: A published notice closes the venue because the current date is an observed public holiday.
temporary_refurbishment: A published notice closes the venue because building, repair or fit-out works are in progress on the current date.
permanent_closure: The page states that the venue has ceased trading, with no date given for reopening.
insufficient_evidence: The page does not establish that the venue is closed today, or it establishes a closure but gives no basis on which to attribute it.

question: Determine whether the operator's cold chain excursion playbook directs disposal of stock from the affected chilled unit. Consider only stock that was inside that unit at some point while the unit was above the playbook's chilled threshold, under the category recorded against it for that period. Answer true if disposal is directed for at least one category that was present in that period, and false if the playbook directs some action other than disposal for every category that was present.
options: True: For at least one product category present in the unit while it was above the threshold, the time above threshold falls in that category's disposal band.

False: For every product category present in the unit while it was above the threshold, the time above threshold falls in a band directing re-chilling, recording or inspection rather than disposal. Stock that left the unit before the first reading above the threshold, and stock that entered after the unit was logged back at or below 4.0 C, was not present in that period.

question: Voice sessions are audited against the live-handoff service level. Measure from the caller's first unambiguous request to be put through to a person to the moment an identified human agent first speaks on the line. Initiating a transfer, entering a queue, hold music and queue-position announcements do not end the measurement. Exactly 120 seconds meets the service level.
options: True: More than 120 seconds passed between the caller's first unambiguous request for a person and the first words spoken by an identified human agent.
False: 120 seconds or fewer passed on that measurement, or the caller never made such a request, or no identified human agent spoke before the session ended.

question: Record the impact level for this case. Record the highest level whose condition is met. A payment instruction counts as altered when a changed account, payee or remittance destination was communicated outside the organisation from the affected account, whether or not any internal system was changed and whether or not the recipient acted on it.
options: Unauthorised access is evidenced but nothing was created, changed or sent from the account.
A persistence artefact such as an inbox rule, delegation or forwarding address was created or altered, and no message was sent from the account to anyone outside the organisation.
Messages were sent from the account to a party outside the organisation, and no payment instruction was altered in them.
A payment instruction was altered in what was sent from the account to a party outside the organisation.

question: Mailbox compromise cases are audited against the containment service level. Measure from the moment the first alert on the affected account was raised to the moment all sign-in sessions and refresh tokens for that account were revoked. Resetting a password, re-enrolling an authentication method, disabling a rule or opening the case do not satisfy the measurement; only revocation of sessions and tokens does. Exactly four hours meets the service level.
options: True: Sessions and tokens for the affected account were revoked within four hours of the first alert being raised on it.
False: Revocation happened more than four hours after the first alert on the affected account, or sessions and tokens were never revoked.

question: Determine whether an alias mapping the spoken form of the artist name, as it appears in the accepted transcript, to the artist entity was in force for this request. An alias restricted to a list of markets is in force only for a request carrying one of those markets; an alias whose market list is a wildcard is in force everywhere. An alias pointing at a playlist or a track is not an alias to the artist entity.
options: True: Such an alias existed at query time and was in force for the market the request carried.
False: No such alias existed at query time, or one existed but was not in force for the market the request carried.

question: Rate the gap in the supplier's tax and banking details required to open the register entry. The five required details are: the supplier's tax personal identification number, the supplier's value added tax registration number, a physical business address, a bank account identified with its branch, and the name of an individual signatory for the supplier. A detail stated anywhere in the record, including inside a quoted earlier message, a letterhead or a footer, counts as present; a rate or percentage of a tax is not a registration number; a statement that a detail will be supplied later does not make it present. Rate by how many of the five are not stated anywhere in the record.
options: All five required details are stated somewhere in the record.
Exactly one of the five is not stated.
Exactly two of the five are not stated.
Exactly three of the five are not stated.
Exactly four of the five are not stated.
None of the five is stated, or the supplier cannot be identified at all.

question: Decide whether the approval on the project registration was validly recorded. Assess only who recorded it and their authority; do not consider whether the activity later matched the registration.
options: True: The approval was recorded by a person other than the person who requested the registration, and that person's delegation is active and carries a limit at or above the amount the registration states.

False: The approval was recorded by the same person who requested the registration, or by a person whose delegation is not active, or by a person whose limit is below the amount the registration states. Naming another person as the one on whose behalf an approval was recorded does not by itself make that other person the recorder.

question: Score how complete the documentary file is. Six items are required on a baggage claim under this product: a completed and signed claim form; a report issued by the carrier or its handling agent for the loss; the ticket or boarding pass for the affected sector; itemised receipts for emergency purchases; the identity page of the claimant's passport; and a letter from the employer confirming the trip was undertaken on company business. Count only items held as indexed attachments on the file. A second copy of an item already counted does not count again. A document that relates to a different trip does not count. Correspondence described on the file but not indexed as an attachment does not count. The score is the number of the six required items present.
options: None of the six required items is present.
Exactly one of the six required items is present.
Exactly two of the six required items are present.
Exactly three of the six required items are present.
Exactly four of the six required items are present.
Exactly five of the six required items are present.
All six required items are present.

"Sprachnotiz — Diktat Außendienst West. Aufnahme 10.09.2026, 17:42, im Wagen zwischen Lekki und Ikeja. Chinedu Okafor, Vertrieb Bioanalytik.

also. gespräch mit Dr. Amaka Nwosu von Sahel Biopharma Ltd, büro Lekki Phase 1, heute nachmittag, knapp fünfzig minuten am telefon. sie ist dort unsere hauptansprechpartnerin seit märz, bei uns unter CON-44812 angelegt, durchwahl und mailadresse unverändert. ihr kollege Emeka war kurz dazugeschaltet, hat aber nichts gesagt.

thema war das bioanalytik-paket für die stabilitätsstudie SB-2211, zwei matrizes, plasma und urin. listenpreis nach unserer preisliste 2026 sind 18.400.000 Naira für das komplettpaket. ich bin heute auf 15.640.000 Naira runtergegangen und habe ihr das so am telefon genannt. im august hatten wir ihr schriftlich 15.200.000 Naira geschickt, das war aber noch der alte umfang ohne die zweite matrix, das habe ich ihr auch erklärt, sie hat das akzeptiert.

sie hat dann gefragt ob wir die zertifikate zur geräteschulung mitschicken können für ihr audit, irgendwann im herbst, kein termin genannt. und sie wollte wissen ob wir im vierten quartal überhaupt noch kapazität haben. beides habe ich offen gelassen, da muss die laborleitung ran.

dann kam die eigentliche frage: wie lange die methodenvalidierung dauert, bis der bericht freigegeben ist. ich habe das direkt am handy im nkemdi nachgeschlagen, während wir telefoniert haben, sitzung SES-2026-0910-77.

die antwort von nkemdi lautete wörtlich: „Der validierte Methodenbericht wird 21 Werktage nach Probeneingang freigegeben. Quelle: https://kb.zaria-cro.ng/sop/lab/BA-114-rev7“ — das war die komplette antwort, mehr stand da nicht, keine tabelle, keine fußnote.

in der quellenleiste darunter standen vier treffer, ich habe einen screenshot gemacht und schicke den nach:
1) Preisliste Bioanalytik 2026 — https://kb.zaria-cro.ng/pricing/bioanalytik-2026 — relevanz 0.81 — stand 02.02.2026
2) SOP BA-114 Rev. 6 Methodenvalidierung — https://kb.zaria-cro.ng/sop/lab/BA-114-rev6 — relevanz 0.77 — stand 14.11.2024 — in der vorschauzeile stand: „Der validierte Methodenbericht wird binnen 21 Werktagen nach Probeneingang freigegeben.“
3) Leistungsbeschreibung Probenlogistik — https://kb.zaria-cro.ng/service/probenlogistik — relevanz 0.64 — stand 30.06.2026
4) FAQ Kundenportal — https://kb.zaria-cro.ng/faq/portal — relevanz 0.41 — stand 19.05.2026
mehr treffer waren in der leiste nicht drin, die liste hat komplett auf den schirm gepasst, ich musste nicht scrollen.

ich habe ihr die 21 werktage dann zugesagt, aber ausdrücklich nur unter der bedingung, dass der zusatz zum rahmenvertrag unterschrieben ist. das habe ich zweimal gesagt: ohne unterschrift fängt die frist nicht an zu laufen. sie hat das so wiederholt, also ist es angekommen.

sie will das ganze schriftlich. wörtlich hat sie gesagt, bis freitag braucht sie die bestätigung der 21 werktage, sonst kommt sie damit im lenkungskreis nicht durch. ich schicke ihr das übermorgen früh raus, vorher muss ich noch mit der laborleitung in Ibadan sprechen, die sitzen bis donnerstag in einer inspektion.

zum preis hat sie nichts schriftliches verlangt, sie nimmt die zahl erstmal so mit. die offene rechnung INV-2026-08-3391 aus august hat sie kurz angesprochen, sie hat nur gefragt wann die rausgegangen ist, die summe hat sie nicht bestritten. da habe ich selbst schon bei der buchhaltung angerufen, Tunde schickt die heute nochmal an die rechnungsadresse, das braucht ihr nicht mehr anzufassen.

noch zur probenlogistik: sie fragt, ob die trockeneis-sendung weiterhin über Ikeja geht oder über den neuen hub. habe ich nicht beantwortet, kommt in die schriftliche bestätigung mit rein.

und sonst: sie hat beiläufig erwähnt, dass sie parallel mit Synexa sprechen, es geht wohl um kapazität im vierten quartal, mehr wollte sie dazu nicht sagen. unser laufender rahmenvertrag mit Sahel läuft bis 31.01.2027.

ach ja, wichtig, das gehört weiter nach oben: ganz am anfang, bevor ich ihr die nkemdi-antwort vorgelesen habe, habe ich ihr gesagt, dass das aus unserem internen assistenzsystem kommt und nicht aus dem vertragstext. erst danach habe ich vorgelesen, wortwörtlich, ohne was wegzulassen.

bitte diesen gesprächsvermerk bei ihr im system hinterlegen, mehr nicht von eurer seite. ende der aufnahme."

question: Assign the single policy category that governs the one comment this case was opened against. Read only the body of that comment; other comments on the same article are not in scope for this question. Where more than one category could describe the content, the category text below says which one wins.
options: veiled_threat_of_violence: Content that suggests, invites or endorses physical confrontation with, or harm to, an identifiable person without naming a specific act, weapon, injury or time. A suggestion of confrontation paired with details of where the person can be found falls here. A person referred to only by an office or role is identifiable where the record establishes a single holder of that office.
explicit_threat_of_violence: Content that names a specific act of physical harm, a weapon, an injury, or a stated time at which harm will be inflicted on an identifiable person.
targeted_harassment: Content directed at a person that demeans, insults or pursues them, and that neither suggests nor endorses physical confrontation or harm.

personal_information_exposure: Publication of a residential address, plot or house number, telephone number, national identity number, vehicle registration, or workplace address of a private individual or an official. This category applies only where the same content does not also suggest or endorse physical confrontation; where both are present in the same content, the threat category applies instead.
hate_speech_protected_class: Content attacking a person or group on the basis of religion, sect, ethnicity, language group, gender or disability.
coordinated_brigading: Content that is part of organised mass posting, shown by matching or near-matching text from several accounts within a short window.
spam_or_scam: Commercial promotion, solicitation of payment, or deceptive links unrelated to the article's subject.
insufficient_evidence: The body of the reported content is not present in the record, or it contains no statement that can be assessed under any category above.

question: Name the authority whose approval this renewal requires. Committed value is the sum of every forward commitment for the next twelve months that sits under the framework being renewed; commitments under any other framework or standalone order are excluded even where the same supplier holds them. A committed value falling exactly on a threshold is approved by the lower of the two authorities that threshold divides.
options: branch_operations_manager: Committed value of GHS 250,000.00 or less.
head_of_procurement: Committed value above GHS 250,000.00 and up to and including GHS 1,000,000.00.

question: Entitlement to bulk downloads continues through a grace period of 30 calendar days after the plan's expiry date. The day after the expiry date is day one, and the thirtieth day is inside the grace period. Decide whether the requester was entitled on the date of the download now in dispute.
options: True: The date of the disputed download falls on or before the thirtieth day of the grace period counted from the expiry date.

False: The date of the disputed download falls after the thirtieth day. A later renewal, and any arrears paid at that renewal, neither extends the grace period nor restores entitlement for a date that already fell outside it; equally, what a web page displayed to the requester on the night in question does not decide entitlement.

question: Before a record is included in a public release it is checked for redaction. Decide whether the record the requester is disputing requires redaction.
options: True: The record sits in the controlled access tier, or the record carries a direct identifier: a personal name, a national identity number, a telephone number, an email address or a full date of birth.

False: The record is in the open or registered tier and carries no direct identifier. A pseudonymous participant reference, an age in years, a sample collection date, a tissue name and an instrument name are not direct identifiers, and the registered tier is a condition on who may download rather than a reason to redact content.
